visual_action: A slideshow of still photos depicting President Joe Biden and First Lady Jill Biden celebrating Halloween at the White House. They are shown walking out of the decorated entrance and then handing out candy to children in various costumes, including a mermaid, a wizard, Batman, and Black Panther.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Visibly present in all photos, handing out candy to children.

cast.name: Jill Biden
cast.evidence: Visibly present in the first two photos alongside Joe Biden, interacting with children.

spoken_summary: The audio is a clip from the movie "Mean Girls." One character asks, "Why are you so obsessed with Halloween?" and another replies, "Halloween is cool."
audio_music: The video starts with a spoken dialogue clip, which is then followed by an upbeat, retro-style synth-pop music track that plays for the remainder of the slideshow. The music has a positive and cheerful tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow of three still photos with basic cuts between them.
central_claim: The Bidens celebrate Halloween at the White House by joyfully giving candy to trick-or-treating children.
intended_effect: To portray the Bidens in a positive, relatable, and family-friendly light, connecting with a popular American tradition.
